scope: Research pilot for repository publication and economic follow-up. Archived EVM inputs; new mechanisms and cohort analysis are modeled.
plan_amendment: v0.2 extends v0.1 after reviewer feedback. One independent coin per foreign publication; anonymous clustering; formal conditional statements; matched economic inputs. Not preregistered. All old grid points retained.
gas_scope: B1 archived median access gas as common accounting coefficients only; excludes new mechanisms, setup, publication, heartbeat and account abstraction overhead
go_gate: Nonzero conditional temporal leakage with valid negative controls; bounded mitigation has a checkable guarantee. Publication novelty remains a separate unpassed gate.
stop_gate: Source replay mismatch, privileged attacker data, leakage in issuer-independent negative controls, or a guard violating its stated support bound

clustering.algorithm: Average-linkage agglomerative clustering to four groups; distance is mismatch rate of shared isolated-update response features; <2 shared features uses uninformative distance 0.5. Handles randomly permuted independently of issuer.
clustering.external_anchor: one fixed public holder handle, then reveal only that holder issuer; label its cluster, measure coverage, precision and wrong assignments.

economics.scope: holder access-gas proxy only; incremental foreign-issuer publication effects from exact coalition replays; no new prices or monetized outage values
